description: Defines the Settings class for managing device power and sleep configurations, including loading, saving, and updating power states, with versioning and timestamp management.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Manages device power settings, including loading, saving, and updating power states, with version control and timestamp tracking.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads Settings from a specified file path.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves current Settings to a specified file path.

methods.name: setMagic
methods.description: Sets the magic number for the settings.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version number of the settings.

methods.name: SetPowerState
methods.description: Updates the current power state and resets the last update timestamp.

methods.name: InactiveDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration in seconds since the last power state change if not ON.

methods.name: SetDeepSleepTimeout
methods.description: Sets the deep sleep timeout in seconds.

methods.name: SetNwStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables or disables network standby mode.

methods.name: printDetails
methods.description: Prints the settings details with a given prefix.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Internal method to save settings to a file descriptor.
